videos.script: Lesson twelve said the host decides. This lesson writes a host, about a hundred lines, in which every one of those decisions is a line you can read. {{title}} It starts two servers with an environment it chose, names their tools so they cannot collide, and tells the model which server each tool came from. {{start}} The environment turned out to need one more variable than the first list had, and the symptom was a tool that failed with no reason. {{env}} The model can ask to read a help article, but the host does the reading, and a file somebody asked for is refused. {{read}} A refund is asked about twice, by two owners: the host's rule before the call, and the server's own question during it. {{refund}} And every call, allowed or refused, leaves a line in an audit file. {{last}}
